Review notes

Visual review of all 82 retained frames on six contact sheets, with selected pairs inspected at source resolution. Preserve entry, reward and control-availability phases: 2152/2272 show reward reveal and Collect; 3353/3533 show cake progress 7/8 then 8/8; 10736/10789 show rocket-event entry before and after Start appears. Store scroll views 4295-4826 retain different offer contents, not a confirmed purchase. Treasure-entry frames 17271/17331 show the same sentence at different font scales, not a verified localization defect. Similar daily-mission frames 2381/2561 remain selected. Frame 18264 includes an OS notification overlay: retain the selected original locally; inspect/redact before external sharing. These are source-grounded procedural observations, not proof of why Victoria selected each frame or a trained model.
